description: This PHP source file defines the MyTimesheetAPI class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for handling API endpoints related to employee timesheets. It extends functionality from EmployeeTimesheetAPI, primarily customizing validation rules for various API methods such as getAll, create, and update.

classes.name: MyTimesheetAPI
classes.description: API class for managing employee timesheet operations, extending EmployeeTimesheetAPI with custom validation logic.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving all timesheet entries, removing the employee number parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new timesheet entry, customizing date validation with TimesheetDateRule.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an existing timesheet entry, removing the employee number parameter.
